name: Charschan Chiropractic & Sports Injury Associates
what_they_do: Chiropractic sports-medicine practice at 490 Georges Rd, with a second office in Scotch Plains. Dr. William Charschan (past medical director for USA Track and Field NJ) treats running, golf and gym injuries plus neck/back/joint pain with in-office rehab, myofascial release, Graston/IASTM and kinesio taping. Also runs certified DOT/CDL physical exams marketed to truck drivers and motor carriers, including same-day certification.
customers: Two distinct groups: local athletes/runners, active adults and injury patients; plus commercial drivers and motor carriers needing DOT/CDL medical certificates - a business-to-business stream rather than purely local consumers.

size_signals.signal: Two offices with separate phone numbers (490 Georges Rd North Brunswick; 1281 Raritan Rd Scotch Plains)
Dedicated DOT/CDL exam service line with its own page and 'same day certifications' claim - implies carrier relationships
Single named doctor; site copyright runs 2023-2026 and the Google profile carries an owner post dated Oct 29, 2026

listing.reviews: count not displayed in the limited logged-out Maps view

website_review.primary_cta: No visible button above the fold on mobile; the action lives in the hamburger menu as 'Request Appointment'
website_review.online_booking_or_quote: No. 'Request Appointment' opens a long Gravity Forms request (subject, location, name, phone, email, date of birth, address) with labelled fields; a human must respond.
website_review.trust_signals: Strong credentials (board certified chiropractic sports physician, past USA Track & Field NJ medical director, biomedical engineering background), certification badges for DOT exams, testimonials and Q&A pages, insurance page, two office addresses
website_review.out_of_date_signs: Mobile home page leaves a large blank white gap under the hero (content not painted), the site is WordPress/Yoast with a crawl-delay of 10, and there is no reviews or star rating anywhere on site despite a 4.8 Google rating
website_review.search_basics: Home title and description combine chiropractic + DOT CDL exams + North Brunswick, service pages exist for each modality and for each office; but hours are not on the home page and there is no LocalBusiness schema
top_issues: No phone number or CTA visible on the mobile first screen
Booking is a callback request with a long form; nothing instant for drivers needing a DOT certificate
Site structure is WordPress template with no LocalBusiness/Chiropractor structured data

agent_readiness.notes: Findable: robots.txt allows all crawlers (Disallow empty) but sets Crawl-delay: 10, which slows OAI-SearchBot/PerplexityBot; the GBP is active (owner post from Oct 2026) with category, hours and phone, though there is no booking button. Answerable: service and body-area lists are rich text, and JSON-LD exists, but the graph only contains WebPage, WebSite, Organization and BreadcrumbList - no LocalBusiness/Chiropractor node with address, hours or price, and no price info is published. Bookable: request form only, six screens of fields (including date of birth and full address) and no availability shown.

operations_signals.signal: DOT/CDL exams are marketed on speed ('instant certifications', same-day) yet the only intake is a callback request form or phone - inference: drivers are waiting on staff to respond
Appointment form collects date of birth and full address before anything is scheduled, so front desk re-keys data into the practice system
Two offices share one doctor and one request form; patients pick 'North Brunswick / Scotch Plains / Either', which needs manual routing

top_opportunities.opportunity: Build a self-serve DOT/CDL exam funnel (online scheduling, pre-visit checklist, document upload, reminders) aimed at drivers and carriers - the highest-intent, most repeatable demand on the site
top_opportunities.evidence: DOT/CDL exams have their own page promising same-day certification, but scheduling is a request form or a phone call

top_opportunities.opportunity: Fix the mobile first screen: put the phone number and a Book/Request button at the top and remove the blank gap, so a visitor at 390px knows what to do
top_opportunities.evidence: Phone screenshot showed logo + hamburger, a hero band and then a large empty white area; the only tel: links sit in the footer

top_opportunities.opportunity: Add LocalBusiness/Chiropractor structured data with hours for both offices and publish exam/visit pricing ranges so an agent can answer 'what does a DOT exam cost and when can I come'
top_opportunities.evidence: JSON-LD contains only WebPage/WebSite/Organization/BreadcrumbList types; no prices published anywhere on site

scores.reasons: Gap: real content and credentials but broken mobile funnel, no scheduling and no local schema. Pay: two offices plus a B2B driver-exam line that carriers pay for, so budget exists. Ease: schema, mobile CTA and a DOT booking form are quick wins. Evidence: reviewed home, request-appointment and robots.txt in browser, phone screenshot at 390px and the Google profile.
